cpa: CPA is an accountant who has passed certain examinations and met all other statutory and licensing requirements of a United States state to be certified by that state.
For example: "In addition to accounting and auditing, CPAs also prepare tax returns for individuals and corporations."
CPA means the same as certified public accountant.
cpi: CPI is an index of the cost of all goods and services to a typical consumer.
CPI can also mean a self-report personality inventory originally derived from the MMPI.
CPI means the same as consumer price index or cost-of-living index or California Personality Inventory.
cpr: CPR is an emergency procedure consisting of external cardiac massage and artificial respiration.
CPR means the same as cardiopulmonary resuscitation or cardiac resuscitation or mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.
cps: A cps is the unit of frequency.
Cps means the same as hertz or Hz or cycle per second.
cpu: CPU is the part of a computer that does most of the data processing.
For example: "The CPU and the memory form the central part of a computer to which the peripherals are attached."
CPU means the same as central processing unit or C.P.U. or central processor.
cpu board: CPU board is the main circuit board for a computer.
CPU board means the same as mother board.
